unit_name: Unit 9: Thriving in What's Next  |  Durable Skill: Collaboration (Applied)  |  Milestone(s): From Here Workbook
title: Understanding the Hidden Curriculum
description: Name the unwritten rules of college — and reframe not knowing as systemic, not personal. What is the hidden curriculum? The unstated expectations and practices that institutions assume students know. For first-gen students, this gap is real and consequential. By naming it explicitly, we take away its power. Students begin the From Here workbook: opening reflection on what they know they'll need to figure out.

unit_name: Unit 9: Thriving in What's Next  |  Durable Skill: Collaboration (Applied)  |  Milestone(s): From Here Workbook
title: Navigating Campus Culture
description: Learn how college culture differs from high school without losing yourself in the process. Academic culture: professors vs. teachers, class participation norms, academic honesty expectations. Social culture: how friendships form in college differently than high school. Identity: how to explore new aspects of yourself while staying rooted in who you are.

unit_name: Unit 9: Thriving in What's Next  |  Durable Skill: Collaboration (Applied)  |  Milestone(s): From Here Workbook
title: Campus Resources
description: Map the full ecosystem of support — and build the mindset to actually use it. Tutoring centers, writing centers, academic advisors, counseling services, financial aid offices, career centers, disability services, cultural centers, food pantries, emergency funds. Students identify the three resources most relevant to their situation and make a plan to visit within the first two weeks.

unit_name: Unit 9: Thriving in What's Next  |  Durable Skill: Collaboration (Applied)  |  Milestone(s): From Here Workbook

description: Get oriented to LMS (Canvas, Blackboard, Moodle), student portals, institutional email, course registration systems, and financial aid portals from day one. Students practice navigating examples of these systems.
alma_integration: ⭐ Arc 1 Alma reflection (10 min): 'What part of the hidden curriculum feels most daunting to navigate? What resources will you call on first?'

unit_name: Unit 9: Thriving in What's Next  |  Durable Skill: Collaboration (Applied)  |  Milestone(s): From Here Workbook
title: Communication with Professors
description: Master the email, the office hour, and the art of advocating for yourself. How to write a professional email to a professor. The office hour: what it is, why professors offer it, how to use it. The ask for help: how to articulate what you don't understand in a way that gets you useful support.

unit_name: Unit 9: Thriving in What's Next  |  Durable Skill: Collaboration (Applied)  |  Milestone(s): From Here Workbook
title: Course Planning and Academic Navigation
description: Build a first-semester plan and learn how to use an academic advisor. How credit hours work, general education requirements, major requirements, electives. How to read a course catalog. Choosing a reasonable first-semester load. The academic advisor relationship.

unit_name: Unit 9: Thriving in What's Next  |  Durable Skill: Collaboration (Applied)  |  Milestone(s): From Here Workbook
title: Academic Success Strategies
description: Unlearn what worked in high school — or finally get the fresh start you deserve. What changes in college: pace, volume of reading, independence, feedback loop. Study strategies that work: spaced practice, active retrieval, study groups. Time management: the college schedule looks freer than it is.
alma_integration: ⭐ Arc 2 Alma reflection (10 min): 'What academic habits do you want to carry forward? What do you want to do differently?'

unit_name: Unit 9: Thriving in What's Next  |  Durable Skill: Collaboration (Applied)  |  Milestone(s): From Here Workbook
title: Health and Wellness Basics
description: Navigate campus health, insurance, and self-care when no one is managing it for you. Health insurance: staying on a parent's plan vs. campus health plan. Campus health center. Sleep, nutrition, and movement as academic performance variables. Students identify their top 2-3 self-care non-negotiables.

unit_name: Unit 9: Thriving in What's Next  |  Durable Skill: Collaboration (Applied)  |  Milestone(s): From Here Workbook
title: Personal Safety and Well-Being
description: Make informed decisions in new environments and know who to call when it matters. Campus safety resources, making safety decisions at social events, bystander intervention basics. Digital safety: privacy online, social media presence in a new context.

unit_name: Unit 9: Thriving in What's Next  |  Durable Skill: Collaboration (Applied)  |  Milestone(s): From Here Workbook
title: Mental and Emotional Wellness
description: Know the difference between a hard week and something more — and how to ask for help. College mental health: anxiety, depression, and adjustment struggles are extremely common. Campus counseling services. When to reach out: not when things become unbearable, but when they start to feel unmanageable. Trauma-informed facilitation.

unit_name: Unit 9: Thriving in What's Next  |  Durable Skill: Collaboration (Applied)  |  Milestone(s): From Here Workbook
title: Roommates and Living with Others
description: Build a functional shared life with someone you didn't choose. The roommate agreement: sleep schedules, guests, cleaning, noise, shared items. Conflict resolution: how to address issues directly and early. For students living at home: the parallel challenges of managing family expectations.
alma_integration: ⭐ Arc 3 Alma reflection (10 min): 'What do you most need to protect about yourself as you enter this next chapter? How will you ask for help when you need it?'

unit_name: Unit 9: Thriving in What's Next  |  Durable Skill: Collaboration (Applied)  |  Milestone(s): From Here Workbook
title: Imposter Syndrome and Belonging
description: Name the feeling, understand where it comes from, and build evidence that you belong. Imposter syndrome is especially common among first-gen students. What it is: the persistent feeling of not belonging despite evidence to the contrary. What helps: finding community, building evidence through action, talking about it with others.

unit_name: Unit 9: Thriving in What's Next  |  Durable Skill: Collaboration (Applied)  |  Milestone(s): From Here Workbook
title: Family Dynamics and Managing Two Worlds
description: Grow into someone new without leaving behind the people and culture that made you. The specific experience of first-gen students: becoming someone your family doesn't fully recognize while remaining someone who belongs to them. Managing family expectations. Communication with family during college.

unit_name: Unit 9: Thriving in What's Next  |  Durable Skill: Collaboration (Applied)  |  Milestone(s): From Here Workbook

title: What Is Character — and Why Does It Matter?
description: Explicit introduction to Character as Unit 2's durable skill. Character encompasses personal and professional conduct — the qualities of integrity, accountability, and ethical decision-making that shape how you show up for yourself and others. In a values unit, Character is the natural companion: values are what you believe; character is how you act on those beliefs, especially when it is hard. title: What Is Mindfulness — and Why Does It Matter?
description: Explicit introduction to Mindfulness as Unit 3's durable skill. Mindfulness is the practice of staying fully present, attentive, and nonjudgmental — in conversations, in decision-making, and in self-reflection. In a purpose unit, mindfulness matters because purpose requires paying attention: to what energizes you, to what feels true, to the difference between your voice and the voices of others. Students explore: What does it mean to be fully present? When do you find it hardest to pay attention to what you actually feel vs. what you think you should feel? How does mindfulness connect to discovering your mission?
